rows.label: Prompt 1
rows.text: A child launches a red kite on a windy beach; the camera cranes up as it catches the air. Waves and gulls, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 2
rows.text: A baker opens an oven and steam rolls into morning light while trays clatter in the background.

rows.label: Prompt 3
rows.text: A night train enters a rural station, brakes squeal, doors open, and one passenger steps onto the wet platform.

rows.label: Prompt 4
rows.text: A fox pauses at the forest edge, listens, then disappears into falling snow; one slow continuous push-in.

rows.label: Prompt 5
rows.text: A street drummer builds a rhythm under an awning as rain intensifies and pedestrians hurry past.

rows.label: Prompt 6
rows.text: A diver descends through clear blue water toward a shipwreck while bubbles and distant whale song fill the audio.

rows.label: Prompt 7
rows.text: A cyclist rounds a mountain bend at sunrise; side-tracking camera, chain and tyre sounds, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 8
rows.text: A potter shapes a tall vase, the clay collapses, and she laughs softly before beginning again.

rows.label: Prompt 9
rows.text: A small robot crosses an abandoned greenhouse as automatic lights wake one row at a time.

rows.label: Prompt 10
rows.text: Two actors rehearse a quiet farewell on an empty stage, then the work lights switch off behind them.

nodes.title: Note: About LTX-2.5
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.5

LTX-2.5 is Lightricks' open video generation model : fast, local-first, and built for production. Run it locally, fine-tune it for your own use case, or integrate it into your pipeline.

**Key highlights:**

- **Pixel Diffusion** : keyframes-first generation that builds every scene on a grid of high-fidelity keyframes for industry-leading pixel quality
- **Diffusion Video Decoder** : sharper faces, legible text, fewer smears in fast motion
- **Native multishot** : one generation yields multiple connected shots holding character, environment, lighting, voice, and style across cuts
- **Custom Gemma 4 12B text encoder** : retains multiple subjects, actions, lighting, detail, and camera direction across complex prompts
- **Dedicated Prompt Enhancer** *(optional)* : a lightweight model that expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions
- **Auto Duration** : predicts the right clip length from the described action before diffusion begins
- **Better distilled model** : carries far more quality, prompt adherence, and motion into a smaller, faster variant
- Carried over from LTX-2.3: native 4K, synchronized audio-video

Official model & files: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
## What this workflow does

This **Text-to-Video** workflow generates a video directly from a text prompt. Write your prompt, optionally enable the Prompt Enhancer, and the model renders a clip with cinematic pixel quality and synchronized audio.

## Subgraph parameters

The **Text to Video (LTX-2.5)** node is a subgraph. Click the **Enter subgraph** button at the bottom of the node to open its internal graph, where you can inspect and fine-tune every step of the pipeline (conditioning, sampler, CFG guider, VAE decode, and more).

| Parameter | What it does |
|---|---|
| prompt | Text prompt describing the scene, action, lighting, camera, and style |
| prompt_enhance | *(Optional, off by default)* Toggle the built-in Prompt Enhancer, which expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions. Requires the separate prompt enhancer model (~10 GB) below and adds ~1-2 min of generation time |
| duration | Clip length in seconds (Auto Duration can predict it from the action) |
| width / height | Output resolution in pixels (e.g. 1280×720) |
| seed | Random seed : set a fixed value to reproduce the same result |
| frame_rate | Frames per second |
| unet_name | Main model: LTX-2.5 distilled transformer (ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| video_vae | Video VAE used for decoding (ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| audio_vae | Audio VAE that produces synchronized audio (ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| clip_name | Text encoder: custom Gemma 4 12B with projection (gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| upscale_model | Latent upscaler applied before decoding for higher-fidelity output |
| prompt_enhance_model | Model checkpoint used by the Prompt Enhancer |

## How to use

1. Download the models listed in **Note: Model Links** and place them in ComfyUI's `models/` folder (the prompt enhancer model is optional - skip it unless you enable **prompt_enhance**)
2. Write your prompt, optionally toggle **prompt_enhance** for short prompts
3. Set **duration** / **width** / **height** / **frame_rate** (defaults work well) and hit **Queue**
4. To dive deeper, click **Enter subgraph** at the bottom of the main node : every internal step (conditioning, sampler, CFG, VAE decode) can be edited there

nodes.title: AI PROMPT ENHANCER — LTX 2.5 GOLD STANDARD

aiPromptState.formula:
You write prompts for LTX-2.5 text-to-video with synchronized audio. Turn the user's rough idea into one executable video prompt. Output only the prompt, with no heading, analysis, Markdown, or quotation wrapper.

Preserve every explicit character, action, line of dialogue, location, style, duration cue, camera instruction, sound, colour, and ending. Do not invent unrelated characters, text, logos, music, or plot events.

Write a compact cinematic plan in natural language. Establish the medium and visual continuity, then describe what is visible at the opening, the subject motion and scene change over time, camera movement and cuts, lighting and atmosphere, and synchronized audio. Use chronological language so the model knows what happens first, next, and at the end. Put dialogue in exact quotation marks and state speaker and delivery. State NO MUSIC when the user excludes music. For a multi-shot request, use explicit time ranges and clean shot boundaries; otherwise keep one continuous shot. Avoid contradictory camera moves and static image-only prose.

Aim for 120-260 words unless the idea is already detailed. No alternatives, negative-prompt dump, or quality-tag list.

nodes.title: FINAL LTX 2.5 GOLD STANDARD PROMPT
widgets_values:
A lone cyclist enters a rain-soaked tunnel at night. The camera follows behind, low and steady, tracking the rider’s silhouette as they move forward through the dark. Rain streaks down the tunnel walls, reflecting the occasional flicker of distant, blurred headlights. Tyres hiss on wet asphalt, a continuous, rhythmic sound. The tunnel’s ambient hum deepens — dripping water, distant echoes, the muffled groan of metal — growing louder as the cyclist advances. No music.

The cyclist’s posture is tense, leaning slightly into the curve of the tunnel. Their shadow stretches long and distorted against the wet concrete. Reflections from overhead lights ripple across the road surface, creating a shimmering, chaotic pattern that moves with the bike’s motion. The camera stays locked to the rear, never panning or tilting, maintaining a consistent distance.

At 0:12, the cyclist slows, then stops abruptly in the center of the frame. The camera holds still for two seconds. No dialogue. No movement. Only the ambient noise intensifies — water drips, wind whistles, the faint crunch of gravel under tires.

The scene ends with the cyclist still, motionless, as the tunnel’s darkness swallows them whole.
